title: How do you feel? Measuring User-Perceived Value for Rejecting Machine Decisions in Hate Speech Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on operationalizing 'user-perceived value' for rejecting machine decisions in hate speech detection, explicitly citing 'social, ethical, or commercial perspectives' as influences on this value. It evaluates models based on these value perceptions, which are shown to be influenced by ethical considerations (e.g., the Blackstone principle regarding false positives vs. false negatives). The core contribution is integrating and measuring these value perceptions in decision-making, which is a component of evaluating or benchmarking morals/ethics in AI systems for high-stakes domains.
